performance.verdict: Meta efficiency is real; Google is a confirmed $813 drain with zero returns.

findings.text: SOW milestone 'Stripe Products QA'd & Done' (due 2026-07-20) shows no verified completion event — money paths unconfirmed 37 days overdue.
Google Ads: $813.24 spent over 28 days, 0 conversions recorded — confirmed zero-result channel dragging blended CPL up silently.
Meta CPL improving: leads +44.44% and CPL -21.1% 7d vs prior 7d; 3-day signal (Aug 23–25: 0+3+8 leads) steady post-weekend drop — trend intact but fragile.
GHL pipeline: 157 contacts, 122 opportunities created, 0 won, 0 appointments — leads arriving but zero pipeline progression signals an intake or follow-up leak, not an ads problem.
GBP direction clicks spiked to 37 of 38 total actions (28d) with 0 calls recorded — organic interest exists but call-through is not converting, possibly a GBP phone setup gap.

suggestions.text: Shift ~$15/day from Google Ads to Meta — Google has 0 conversions on $813.24 over 28 days.
suggestions.monday_update: Reduce Google Ads daily budget by ~$15/day and apply it to Meta (BWS retarget campaign) immediately. Google Ads has produced 0 conversions on $813.24 of 28-day spend while Meta is delivering leads at a CPL 21.1% lower week-over-week. Success is confirmed if Meta leads hold or rise within 7 days and blended CPL stays at or below the current $15.94. Re-check by 2026-09-02.

suggestions.text: Audit GHL pipeline: 122 opps created, 0 won, 0 appointments — diagnose intake or follow-up automation break.
suggestions.monday_update: Review the Device Fulfilment pipeline and lead-response automation in GHL to identify why 122 created opportunities have produced zero appointments and zero wins. Check trigger firing, assignment rules, and SMS/email sequences for new contacts. Success is at least one confirmed appointment booked through the automated flow by 2026-09-02. This is a CRM ops fix, not an ads change.

suggestions.text: Watch Stripe QA milestone (overdue 37 days): Becklar and BWS money paths must be verified before any further scale.
suggestions.monday_update: The Stripe Products QA milestone was marked done on 2026-07-20 but has no verified completion event — Becklar billing drop and BWS duplicate-order checks are both flagged as ⛔ scale blockers in the SOW. Run the dummy deactivation and dual-path order test described in the SOW before approving any budget increases. Confirm both paths clean by 2026-09-02; if not resolved, escalate to Nacer.
